note: The Ingling dam's crest road (private service bridge over the weir, project col -30 to 115, row 3161-3139). OSM tags it layer=1, as the footbridge 65198985 (bicycle, metal, lit) slung on the weir's downstream face 3 m beside it. The surface model has the road at 308.5-308.9 m (LoD2's weir piers 308.5 m) and the footbridge at 306-307.5 m. voxelize.py builds one deck per layer from the low end of that layer's ways within 10 m, so the road's deck came out at the footbridge's 306.6 m: 2.3 m under its own level over 36 m (deck_sag), a 2 m step down from the piers' tops. A layer of its own (2) gives the road its own deck at the surface model's level. In OSM the two ways do not cross, so layer=2 there would be a possible but not a needed correction.
